The closest match is Structural Segmentation for Brazilian Legal Document Retrieval, which studies structural segmentation for Brazilian legal documents and compares hierarchy-based and chunk-based representations for retrieval [1]. It reports that structural segmentation improves dense retrieval over whole-document indexing, but not consistently lexical retrieval [1].

If you meant a different paper by Fernandes, the other Fernandes-authored papers here are about Brazilian Portuguese IR datasets and judge evaluation, Jev-as-a-judge, and legal retrieval benchmarks, but they do not specifically focus on segmentation [2, 3, 7].
